recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered collage featuring high-contrast halftone portraits of a musical group against a corrugated cardboard background, anchored by vibrant red hand-drawn script lettering and formal serif subtitles in black bars.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black and white figures against a warm tan textured backdrop
Vibrant red script overlapping the central subjects to create depth
Structured black horizontal bars containing formal typography at the top and bottom
Vertical corrugated lines providing a rhythmic texture behind the subjects
coreInvariants: High-contrast halftone effect on all photographic elements
Primary red accent color for the main title
Black rectangular bars for secondary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five male figures in suits arranged in a staggered, overlapping formation filling the central and lower frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright red script lettering in the center of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top black bar, moves down through the red script, and settles on the lower subtitle bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, with the cardboard texture visible primarily at the edges and between the figures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the black ink and the mid-tone background, with a single high-saturation red element.

letterConstructionRules: Thick, consistent stroke weight suggesting a felt-tip marker or brush
Slightly irregular baselines and varying letter heights
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters are oversized and expressive
Lowercase 'a' and 'l' have exaggerated loops or tails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, informal script paired with rigid, formal serif for a professional yet soulful look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the hand-drawn, energetic feel of the central title.
Provides the necessary classic, formal contrast for the subtitles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage of five men in 1960s suits using high-contrast black and white halftone photography. Arrange them in a staggered group. Place them on a background of brown corrugated cardboard with visible vertical ridges. Add a black horizontal bar at the very top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, vibrant red hand-drawn script lettering across the center, overlapping the figures. Inside the top and bottom black bars, add centered, white serif text with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the red script the most prominent element?
Does the cardboard texture show vertical ridges?
Are the figures rendered in high-contrast halftone?
Are there black bars at the top and bottom?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the red script strokes
Number of figures in the collage
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artists
Exact wording of the original titles

mustAchieve: Dynamic overlapping of text and image
avoid: Standard system fonts for the script

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red script is legible against the black and white figures.
Verify the halftone dots are visible in the portraits.
Check that the cardboard texture feels tactile and aged.
Confirm the black bars are perfectly horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Halftone Group Portrait] + [Corrugated Cardboard Backdrop] + [Vibrant Red Hand-Script] + [Formal Serif in Black Bars] to create a retro soul aesthetic.
